situation: Just joined a running club's WhatsApp group, about 40 people. I'm slow and training for my first half marathon in March. Want to say hi.
reply: Hi all, I'm Tessa, just joined after lurking at the Saturday parkrun for a month. I'm training for my first half, Brighton in March, and I'm firmly at the back at about 6:40 per km. Off the track I teach Year 5, so I'm good at herding and bad at hills. Anyone else doing Brighton, or up for a slow Sunday long run?
note: Stating the pace up front invites the right people to reply.

situation: I'm taking over an account from a colleague who left. Need to introduce myself by email to the client's marketing team.
reply: Hi all, I'm Rohan, and I'm taking over as your account manager from Beth, who left on Friday. I've spent four years running paid search for retail brands, and I've read every campaign note Beth left, so nothing resets. Outside work I'm usually on a cricket pitch in Leyton on Sundays. Could we do 30 minutes next week so you can tell me what's working and what isn't? Tuesday or Thursday afternoon both suit me.
note: For a handover, the reassurance that nothing resets is the one thing they most need to hear.

situation: New PhD student, have to introduce myself at the lab's first group meeting. About 30 seconds, spoken.
reply: Hi, I'm Kwame, first-year PhD with Professor Lindqvist. I did my master's in Accra on soil microbes under drought, and I'm here to take that into root imaging. I'm also new to Uppsala and have never owned a winter coat, so advice on that is very welcome. And whoever runs the confocal bookings, I'd love ten minutes with you.
note: The coat line is the hook people will actually use to start a conversation.

situation: 孩子刚转学到三年级二班，被拉进了家长群，两百多人。想发个自我介绍，不想太长也不想像打广告。
reply: 各位家长好，我是新转来的周子航的妈妈刘婧。我们上个月刚从成都搬到杭州，住在学校东边的翠苑小区。我在医院做药剂师，孩子用药方面有拿不准的可以问我。子航特别爱踢球，周末要是有小朋友在小区踢，欢迎叫上他！
note: 家长群里先说清是谁的家长，给一个真能帮上忙的点，再留一个让人容易接话的邀请。

situation: I start Monday as engineering manager for a payments team of 7. Their last manager left suddenly and one of them applied for my job. I want to post a short hello in the team Slack channel on day one.
reply: Hi all, I'm Nadia, and from today I'm managing the payments team. I spent the last five years leading the checkout team at Brightline, so I know how much of this work is invisible until it breaks. Outside work I'm usually at the climbing wall or failing at sourdough. I'll book 30 minutes with each of you over the next two weeks, and mostly I want to hear what's working that I shouldn't touch.
note: New manager of an inherited team: signal listening over change, and don't single out the internal candidate in a group post.

situation: 上周在广州家具展上跟一个做酒店采购的赵经理聊了几句，加了微信，但他应该不记得我了。我们是做实木餐椅的工厂，想发个自我介绍，别像群发广告。
reply: 赵经理您好，我是佛山木森家具的陈晓。上周四在广州家具展3号馆，我们聊过您那边新开的两家酒店餐厅要换椅子。我们厂专做实木餐椅，给酒店做的款主要是好打理、耐磕碰。我自己是木工学徒出身，椅子每一步怎么做的都能讲清楚。您方便的话，我下周把三款酒店常用的样册发您看看？
note: 先帮对方想起你是谁（时间、地点、聊了什么），只讲一件具体的事，最后给一个很小的下一步。

situation: I'm on a panel about small-business websites at a local startup meetup on Thursday Oct 15. The organiser wants a third-person bio under 60 words. I'm a freelance developer in Bristol, six years in, mostly bakeries and cafés.
reply: Lena Novak is a freelance web developer who has spent six years building sites for bakeries, cafés and other small food businesses. Her latest, an online ordering system for three Bristol bakeries, now takes 40% of their orders. She lives in Bristol with a sourdough starter she has kept alive since 2019.
note: A bio still needs one concrete result and one human hook; the hook is what the moderator will use to introduce you.

situation: I'm a freelance UX designer starting a 10-week redesign of a regional credit union's mobile app. Kickoff video call is Thursday Oct 1 with about eight people from their team, and most have never worked with an outside designer. I get about a minute to introduce myself.
reply: Hi everyone, I'm Priya, and I'll be leading the design on the app redesign for the next ten weeks. I've done similar work for two other credit unions, and the thing I care most about is that your members can still find their balance without thinking a year from now. Before design I was a bank teller for three years, so I've heard every complaint about banking apps in person. I'll be asking a lot of questions this week, and none of them are traps. If there's one thing members call you about more than anything, I'd love to hear it today.
note: With a client team wary of outsiders: one relevant credential, one human hook that shows you get their members, and an invitation to talk.
